content.intro: In this lesson, you will work through finding descendants with .find() with a focused jQuery example. The subtopics below preserve the supplied curriculum coverage and connect the API idea to a small browser interface.
content.why_it_matters: This topic is useful because it turns finding elements at any descendant depth into a repeatable implementation choice. Traversal starts from an existing selection and moves through its ancestors, descendants, or siblings. Scope traversal to the component you mean instead of repeating broad document-wide queries.
